title: Blob in the Theater
content: So several days ago I got reminded of an actual "Mall dream". The dream was several years ago and In my dream I was watching a movie in the movie theater at a local mall with someone I presume was my dream girlfriend. All of a sudden a giant blob monster came out of the movie screen and consumed people in the front row luckily I was in the back and me and my Dream GF ran out but another blob came out of another movie theater. So me and her ran into another theaterwe were safe in there for awhile. The a blob fell from the projection booth. As we were trying to get away she got osmosised by the blob screaming Whyyyy. I successfully ran out of the theater dodging blobs into the Mall. All the doors leading outside where locked with a metal gates down so I couldn't hid. More and more blobs kept appearing and everyone was trying to hide. It got all lord of the flies for the hiding places from one shop to another. Eventually everyone got consumed via osmosis by the blobs.
